1662-2645-3181-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
1662-2645-3181-3430.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2023-3755-4518-5434.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3129-5254-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3129-5254-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-5457--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding an additional {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-4875-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
728-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-6972-8095--112.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
284-6972-8095--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

222-527-955-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-955-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-1445-4871-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-4871-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

225-6441-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2685-3263-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3263-4017-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-4762-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2724-6432-6568.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Y'shtola Rhul. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a type chosen that matches a type of the persist creature

345-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat.

2366-3322-4478-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3322-4478-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7373-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Tellah
1618-2440-7373-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Tellah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7373-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Tellah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-7060-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7060-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Smellerbee so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

1661-2033-3459-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

725-1329-3661-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Shield Sphere, adding {1}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Shield Sphere, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

7-413-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-413-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-413-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf trigger,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie Rogue.
When the Zombie Rogue dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Ebondeath spell. When Ebondeath enters, Blasting Station and Geralf's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Geralf trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-413-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

4050-4863-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4050-4863-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Revolutionist and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Revolutionist, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

392-5742-5743-6441.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Harnfel ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5686-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5686-5805--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2191-3174-6085.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Cast Switcheroo by paying {4}{U}, exchanging control of Altanak and another creature with an opponent.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

3259-4068-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
You control at least one Mountain.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-4068-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

1187-1367-2114.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara's Oathsworn does not have summoning sickness and has exactly three +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block Ayara's Oathsworn.
1187-1367-2114.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ayara's Oathsworn.
Ayara's Oathsworn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
Activate Ion Storm by paying {1}{R} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ayara's Oathsworn, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

1339-1918-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1339-1918-3259.description:
Declare Two-Headed Hellkite and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Two-Headed Hellkite triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God's first ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to an Insect token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

774-2137-3105.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
774-2137-3105.description:
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand from the battlefield, copying Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands onto the battlefield tapped from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-1409-3745.notablePrerequisites:
Identity Thief does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Identity Thief.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Identity Thief.
1267-1409-3745.description:
Declare Identity Thief as an attacker.
Identity Thief triggers, exiling Medomai and causing Identity Thief to become a copy of Medomai until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Identity Thief.
Identity Thief triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Identity Thief triggers.
Holding priority, activate Identity Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Identity Thief enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Identity Thief and Deadeye Navigator.
Resolve the Identity Thief trigger, returning Medomai from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

1505-2011-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
Krenko has a power of four or greater.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Krenko.
1505-2011-4050.description:
Declare Krenko as an attacker.
Krenko triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and creating at least five 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five creatures, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

83-687-2012-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Mortician Beetle and removing both counters from Strangleroot Geist.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Strangleroot Geist's undying ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 and a vigilance counter.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist, adding {C}{C}.
Mortician Beetle triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 5, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Strangleroot Geist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

862-2034-3249.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
